areas.title: Responsible AI & governance
areas.description: Assessing whether explainability methods can support AI oversight and regulation, including XAI desiderata derived from the EU AI Act, plus ethics review and public engagement with the Responsible AI in Prague team.

areas.title: Mechanistic interpretability
areas.description: Understanding what neural networks compute, with sparse autoencoders, circuit discovery, and neurosymbolic methods that give provably sufficient explanations of graph neural networks.

areas.title: Applied ML & LLMs
areas.description: Five years of industry ML engineering and Python development, from Transformer-based NLP to shipped LLM applications with RAG, tools, and guardrails.
